decision.reason: [ev-b182e7794768] lists `cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods` under "Added Metrics", so the change type "added" is supported. But the subject is a Prometheus metric, and no subject family covers metrics. Protocol-behavior is for wire/protocol behaviour, so mapping a metric to it is a taxonomy stretch, and the cilium-operator component is only inferred from the metric name. The taxonomy needs a metric family, or a ruling on which family metrics belong to, before this can be decided consistently.
